note: Concise local knowledge base — the CWEs the taint analyzer emits plus common web/Top-25 weaknesses. Offline, 0 cloud tokens.

entries.name: OS Command Injection
entries.description: The software builds an OS command from external input without neutralising special elements, letting an attacker run arbitrary commands.
entries.mitigation: Avoid the shell; pass arguments as a list (no shell=True). Use allowlists; never concatenate user input into a command string.

entries.name: SQL Injection
entries.description: User-controlled input is concatenated into a SQL query, letting an attacker alter the query's logic.
entries.mitigation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements. Never build SQL by string formatting.

entries.name: Code Injection
entries.description: Untrusted input flows into a dynamic code evaluator (eval/exec/compile), allowing arbitrary code execution.
entries.mitigation: Never eval/exec untrusted input. Use safe parsers (ast.literal_eval, json) for data.

entries.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
entries.description: Deserialising attacker-controlled data with an unsafe loader can instantiate arbitrary objects and execute code.
entries.mitigation: Never unpickle/yaml.load untrusted data. Use yaml.safe_load and signed/whitelisted formats (JSON).

entries.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
entries.description: The server fetches a URL derived from user input, letting an attacker reach internal services or metadata endpoints.
entries.mitigation: Validate/allowlist destinations; block internal ranges and redirects; do not pass user URLs to fetchers directly.

entries.name: Path Traversal
entries.description: User input is used to build a filesystem path without neutralising '..', letting an attacker read/write outside the intended directory.
entries.mitigation: Resolve and confirm the path stays within a base dir; reject '..'; use safe join + realpath checks.

entries.name: Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
entries.description: Untrusted input is rendered into a web page without escaping, letting an attacker run script in a victim's browser.
entries.mitigation: Context-aware output encoding; use a template engine's auto-escaping; sanitise HTML.

entries.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
entries.description: Secrets embedded in source can be extracted by anyone with access to the code or binary.
entries.mitigation: Move secrets to environment variables or a secrets manager; rotate any committed secret.

entries.name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
entries.description: Weak algorithms (MD5, SHA1, DES) or misused crypto undermine confidentiality/integrity.
entries.mitigation: Use vetted algorithms (SHA-256+, AES-GCM) and libraries; never roll your own crypto.

entries.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
entries.description: A state-changing request can be forged from another site because it lacks an unguessable token.
entries.mitigation: Use anti-CSRF tokens; SameSite cookies; verify Origin/Referer for state-changing actions.

entries.name: XML External Entity (XXE)
entries.description: An XML parser resolves external entities from untrusted XML, enabling file read or SSRF.
entries.mitigation: Disable external entity/DTD processing; use defused parsers.
common: lxml/etree parsing untrusted XML with entity resolution on

entries.name: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
entries.description: Accepting and storing executable uploads can let an attacker run code on the server.
entries.mitigation: Allowlist types, store outside webroot, randomise names, never execute uploads.
common: save uploaded .php/.jsp into a served dir

entries.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information
entries.description: The product discloses sensitive data (errors, tokens, PII) to an unauthorised actor.
entries.mitigation: Scrub errors/logs; least-privilege responses; never return secrets or stack traces to clients.

entries.name: Improper Authentication
entries.description: Authentication can be bypassed or is not enforced where required.
entries.mitigation: Enforce auth on every protected path; use vetted auth libraries; fail closed.
common: missing auth check on an endpoint
